text:
alex: noticed a big reconnect spike in EU edge after rollout of the new swarm routing policy last night. ~15m window, reconnects ~3x baseline, some tenants reporting duplicate charges. Anyone else seeing this?
joel: yep, console & traces show surge. resume-failures jump and we see full session recreation. linked dashboard: /dashboards/streams/eu-reconnects
maria: the canary flip changed the drain policy from graceful -> force to speed migration. i worried about stray sockets but assumed resume tokens would bridge it. :grimacing:
alex: logs show resume-token mismatches when route table flips mid-session; client reconnects but server treats as brand new session -> billing increments. snippet:
```text
2026-03-21T23:02:11Z WARN resume failed token=abc123 reason=shard-mismatch
2026-03-21T23:02:11Z INFO creating new session session_id=xyz789 client_ip=1.2.3.4
```
joel: yikes. can we fallback to sticky routing during the drain window instead of killing sockets?
samir: low-effort mitigation: accept token from previous route-generation for N seconds. that would avoid dup-charges for in-flight clients.
natasha: that weakens the canary drain guarantees though — could block traffic movement. it's a tradeoff between correctness and user cost.
maria: product/console question: should the rollout UI warn about "estimated duplicate-charge risk" when changing drain policy? PMs asked for clearer risk surface.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: route-service v2 -> 2026-03-21T22:58:03Z :rocket:
ops-bot: alert: reconnect spike detected 2026-03-21T23:01:00Z - EU - 3x baseline - incident INC-4321
joel: mitigation idea: temporarily revert to graceful drain and hold canary at 0% for 10 minutes to let sessions settle. low blast radius.
alex: doing a rollback flag now — preserving resume-token namespace mapping for 60s while we patch. will push in a min.
samir: long-term: make resume tokens include route-gen id and allow +/-1 generation acceptance. also emit a metric when token-gen is accepted from previous gen.
natasha: add console telemetry: per-rollout "dupe-risk" estimate and a tag on metric spikes -> UX ticket https://redwood/ux/ROLL-501 created.
maria: gateway patch idea: when route-change detected at accept-time, emit metrics stream.resume.invalid_tokens and stream.resume.accepted_grace and a trace annotation.
alex: can someone ping billing? tenants affected will need credits for duplicate bill events. @finance-team
joel: on it, creating billing adjust ticket BILL-210 and cc'ing support ops.
alex: thanks. i'll draft a short postmortem with timeline + why the drain flip caused token mismatches and the rollback decision. keep notes here and i will pull into the PM/ENG followup. :thumbsup:
